params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: company_id
params.description: The id for the company whose documents to request. You can get a company's id by making a request to the `/companies` endpoint.

params.name: parse_state
params.description: The parse state of the documents to request. One of "not-started", "in-progress", "completed", "needs-input", "not-parseable".

params.name: from
params.description: The from date (inclusive) from which to query uploaded_at as an ISO 8601 formatted date

params.name: to
params.description: The to date (inclusive) from which to query uploaded_at as an ISO 8601 formatted date

params.name: source
params.description: The source of the documents to request. One of "information-request", "implementation", "upload", "email".

items.docs:
Retrieve all documents associated with the firm. Includes parsed and unparsed documents from various sources.

**Notes:**
- If no company is specified, returns documents for all companies.

**Permissions:**
- User must be authenticated via OAuth.
- User must have access to the documents.

**Notes:**
- File size limit: 32 MB maximum.
- Accepted file types:

    - Microsoft Word documents (.docx)
    - Microsoft Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx)

    - OpenDocument spreadsheets (.ods)

items.docs:
Download a specific document by redirecting to signed URL. Provides temporary access to securely stored documents.

The signed URL expires after 1 hour. After expiration, a new request must be made to obtain a fresh download link.

**Permissions:**
- User must be authenticated via OAuth.
- User must have access to the document.
